via.name: junction with Cathedral Cove Gateway Trail
via.quote: After the junction with the private Cathedral Cove Gateway Trail

evidence: Mautohe Cathedral Cove Track starts at the top of Grange Road, Hahei.
After the junction with the private Cathedral Cove Gateway Trail, the track descends steeply to Mares Leg Cove.
Return to the car park the same way you came.

access_points.name: Cathedral Cove Gateway Trail car park
access_points.quote: Cathedral Cove Gateway Trail car park at 150 Lees Road, Hahei

doubts: The text ends the track at Mares Leg Cove, where the rock archway leads through to Mautohe Cathedral Cove beach; the end is recorded as Mares Leg Cove, though walkers may pass through the archway to Cathedral Cove (T3). The text says 'Return to the car park' although there is no parking at the Grange Road entrance. The lookout side trip is 'signposted off' the track without saying where.
